svg.text: R9 = R2 + R5: the add in vector add, at offset 0x0110. Sixteen bytes, four 32-bit words.

svg.text: SB4 is the scoreboard both loads (LDG.E R2 and LDG.E R5) set: the add waits until both values have arrived from memory.
